_notes: output_modalities=all lists every model group (chat, image, embeddings, rerank, video, speech, transcription, decisions); without it /models only returns text models.
Decisions are at /api/alpha/decisions: the base URL with /v1 replaced by /alpha.
Images and image edits both POST /images; edits are JSON with the pictures as data URLs in input_references, and no mask (endpoints.imageEdit).
Image and video options come per model from /images/models and /videos/models; suggest covers what no list gives. /audio/speech only returns mp3 or pcm (pcm does not play in the page).
guide is the text of the Providers tab: how hard the setup is (level 1-4 and ease), a summary, the steps, and what is good or to watch. Shown with the signup link.
label: OpenRouter

signup.text: No key? Get one at OpenRouter

guide.summary: Sign in, add credit, make a key. Every model is switched on from the start, so there is nothing else to set up.
steps: Sign in at openrouter.ai, for example with your Google account.
Add credit under Credits (pay as you go).
Create a key under Keys and paste it at the top of this page.
good: All models are available at once, with nothing to enable.
Works straight from this page (GitHub Pages), no server needed.
Has every tab here, including video and rerank.
watch: Pay as you go: the key spends your credit, so set a limit on the key if you share it.
